notes.title: 📢 Update: Company Branches Are Here! 🏢🌍
notes.content:
This update introduces the new system of company branches!
Companies can now open branches in different countries and manage them individually. Each branch comes with its own assets, market share, marketing expenses, and pricing strategies.

🆕 Key Changes

🏢 Open new branches in different nations

📊 Independent management of assets and expenses for each branch

👥 Separate calculation of market share and customer reach

🌎 Integration with GDP and local market segmentation

🚀 Nearly doubled the number of companies available in the game

This update brings a broader strategic layer, allowing you to handle each national market separately and plan your company’s global presence more effectively.

notes.title: Game Update: Short Stock Operation Now Available!
notes.content:
We’ve added a powerful new financial tool to your strategic arsenal: Short Selling.
With the Short Stock Operation, you can now sell shares you don’t own, aiming to repurchase them later at a lower price. It’s a calculated way to profit from overvalued stocks or anticipated declines in a company’s value.

Key Points:

Profit from falling stock prices
Target overvalued or weakening companies
Adds new strategic depth and risk to market play

Use it wisely. The market just became more dynamic and competitive.

💹 Update Now and Test Your Strategy

notes.title: Demo Game Update: New Financial Operations Now Available!
notes.content:
Big moves are shaking up the market! In this latest update, we’ve added several powerful financial operations that give you even more strategic control over your companies. Here's what's new:

💰 LBO (Leveraged BuyOut)
Take your company private by buying back public shares—especially smart when the stock is undervalued. But beware: increased debt can damage your credit rating.

💰 Greenmail
Negotiate directly with major shareholders to buy out their stake. A costly but effective way to remove hostile investors and tighten your control.

💰 Extraordinary Dividend
Distribute a one-time special dividend to shareholders. Great for rewarding investors—but watch your cash reserves and credit rating. And don’t forget: it’s taxable!

💰 Stock Split
Split your company’s shares to improve market perception and liquidity. This is a cosmetic change—your total value stays the same, but it might attract new interest.

💰 Restructure
Need fast cash? Sell off assets at a steep discount to stay afloat. A risky move, but sometimes necessary for survival.

Make your move wisely—every action has consequences. Jump back in and see how the market responds!

💹 Update Now and Test Your Strategy

notes.title: Dev Week #22
notes.content:
📢 Development Update – AI, CEO & Major Improvements!
Hey everyone! 👋 Our team has been working hard to bring new features, improvements, and bug fixes to the game. Here’s what’s new in this update!

🚀 Major Tasks – Big Additions!
✅ AI Bank – AI-controlled banks now make autonomous decisions, enhancing economic simulation!
✅ AI Investor – AI investors now analyze opportunities and make more realistic decisions!
✅ AI Company – AI companies now operate with more advanced logic, creating a more dynamic market!

🏦 New Mechanics & Improvements
✅ CEO Strategy Enhancements:

 Debt Management – The CEO can now choose between bank loans or bonds for financing.
 Liquidity Strategy – Decide whether to distribute dividends or reinvest in expansion.
 CEO Term Expiration – CEO terms now have expiration dates.
 CEO Performance History – Track past CEO performance to make informed decisions!
 CEO Selection Panel – A new system to choose the best CEO for your company.

✅ Financial System Enhancements:

 Investor List – You can now view all investors in a company.
 Bankruptcy System – Bankruptcy mechanics are now more realistic and impactful.
 Bank Buy Assets Costs – Bank-acquired assets now have a cost range of 10-15%.

✅ UI/UX Improvements:

 Empty Scroll Fix – If a scroll section is empty, it now displays “No Elements.”
 Improved Closing & Returning from Company/Bank Info Screens – More intuitive navigation.
 Real Estate Row Handling for Other Investors – Better management for external investors.

✅ Autopilot & Majority Ownership:
When selling a majority stake in a company, autopilot is now automatically disabled.

 🛠️ Bug Fixes – Stability & Performance Fixes
 ✅ DB Scrollbar Crash – Fixed a crash caused by the database scrollbar.
 ✅ Shareholders Scrollbar – Fixed scrolling issues in the shareholder list.

🔮 What’s Next?
We’re already working on more exciting features and improvements! Keep sending your feedback, and stay tuned for the next update!

Thanks for your support! 🚀🔥
